title: Mold Remediation Debris Haul Trip Charges
content:
Mold Remediation debris leaves the site on the haul days, and the haul-off line carries a trip charge according to those days.

**Rule.** The haul days are the latest drywall removal date and the latest insulation removal date on the job; when both kinds of removal are booked and those two dates differ, the debris leaves on two trips and the two-trip charge of 150.00 is added; when the removal is on a single date that is not the job's containment date, the debris leaves on its own trip and the one-trip charge of 75.00 is added; when the removal is on the containment date, the debris rides out with the setup truck and no trip charge is added.

## Training questions

**What is a haul day?** For each kind of removal booked on the job, its latest removal date: the latest drywall removal date and the latest insulation removal date.

**Both kinds are booked and their latest dates differ.** Two trips: 150.00.

**Both kinds are booked with the same latest date, or only one kind is booked.** The haul days come to a single date. If that date is not the job's containment date, one trip: 75.00. If it is the containment date, no trip charge.

**Only drywall is booked, on the containment date and again two days later.** The haul day is the latest drywall removal date, two days after the containment date, so one trip: 75.00.

**Hypothetical dates, containment set 2 May:**

| Latest drywall removal | Latest insulation removal | Trip charge |
|---|---|---|
| 3 May | 4 May | 150.00 |
| 3 May | 3 May | 75.00 |
| 2 May | none booked | None |
| none booked | 5 May | 75.00 |
